name: Hendre — friendly navy & red home repair

source.template: Hendre – Handyman / Home Repair HTML5 template (index.html)
source.method: Computed styles measured in Chromium at 1440px (scripts/extract-template.mjs → measured.json); reference-1..5.jpg are the full page in order. Grey 'PHOTO' tiles are photo slots — keep their size and position, fill them with the lead's real photos.

character: Approachable, trustworthy home-repair brand. Deep navy #062462 + signal red #da242b on white, Inter headings with ONE word per heading picked out in red, Poppins body, house-shaped red icon badges, a big white feature panel overlapping the hero, a red vertical bracket framing the hero headline, and buttons with a notched '+' tab. Feels local, friendly and dependable.
reuse: Use for handyman / home repair / home services / plumbing / electrical / HVAC / roofing / painting / cleaning / pest control / appliance repair leads that want a friendly, trustworthy two-colour look. Put the lead's brand colour in the navy 'primary' slot and keep a strong contrasting accent (red by default, or a warm tint of the brand) for highlights.

display.note: Headings. Hero 58/800 UPPERCASE navy. Section h2 40/700 with ONE key word (often the brand or the service) in red.

body.note: Body 15px/1.87 grey #616161; buttons and nav 15/500 Poppins.

scale.note: sits on the top arm of a red ⌐-shaped bracket that runs down the left of the headline
two-colour: navy with a red highlight word
'For Enquiry:' 15px/300 label above, 60px red circle phone icon beside
white over a photo, with a 15px label

color.notes: Navy carries structure (header, buttons, caption bars, footer); red carries emphasis (eyebrows, one heading word, house badges, card side-rules, primary CTA in the header). Map the lead's brand colour to navy; keep a contrasting accent.

spacing.container: 1280px max content column with 32px side padding (20px under 768px) — the SAME column for top bar, header, every section and footer. (Template measured 1320px; standardised to 1280 so every mockup shares one grid.)
spacing.sectionPaddingY: 88px top / 70px bottom (about 135/100; services header band 88 then cards overlap it)
spacing.headingStack: red uppercase eyebrow → 14px → 40px two-colour h2 → 20px → paragraph → 50px → content
spacing.panelPadding: 80px inside the white overlapping feature panel (radius 10, soft navy shadow)
spacing.header: 50px navy top bar (address · email left; coloured square social cells + 'Call Us: <phone>' right) + 99px header: logo on navy on the left, then a WHITE nav box (radius 0) spanning the rest with nav 15/500 navy, a round grey search button and a red 'Get a Free Quote' button
spacing.hero: 790px photo with a pale house-outline illustration; headline block left with the red bracket; a large 753×728 photo cut-out on the right

components.button: Navy, 60px tall, radius 5px on the left and pill on the right, with a small white circled '+' tab poking out of its right edge. The header CTA is a plain red 52px button radius 5.
components.featurePanel: White 10px-radius panel that overlaps the bottom of the hero by ~120px: left eyebrow + two-colour h2, right a red phone circle + 'For Enquiry' number; below, 3 photo cards (410×347) with a red HOUSE-SHAPED icon badge at the top-left and a navy caption bar at the bottom (with a small triangle notch pointing up into the photo). A diagonal-hatch strip peeks out under the panel.
components.aboutSplit: 607×576 photo left with a white stat ('795+ Project Completed') over it; right: eyebrow, h2, paragraph, an icon feature (80px pale tile + 20px title + text), a 2×2 checklist with red circle checks, and the navy '+' button.
components.serviceCards: A photo header band (navy overlay, white h2 left, round navy prev/next arrows right) that the cards overlap: 3 white cards, photo on top, red house badge straddling the photo edge, 22px title, 2 lines, navy '+' button, and a 14px red vertical rule down the right side of each card.
components.whyChoose: Pale band, centred two-colour h2, a round outlined PLAY button (video), then 3 tab buttons (01. / 02. / 03.) and a tab panel with photo + text.
components.process: Navy photo band, 4 steps with 36px red numbered circles connected by a dashed line, 22px white titles.
components.testimonials: Dark photo band, carousel of quote cards with 18px light quote text, round avatar, 18px name.
components.blog: White, 3 cards with photo, a navy pill 'By Admin' meta chip, 22px title.
components.footer: #052361, a top row (phone callout + newsletter 'Subscribe Now' with a #f6f6f6 52px input), then 4 columns, 22px/600 column titles, #cdd3df text.
